Today, besides launching two new products, Sonos also announced the "Sonos 27" branding for its software platform and detailed four new features that will soon be available to Sonos users.

The following are the four new "Sonos 27" features launching this fall

Sonos today launched the Sonos Ace Ultra over-ear headphones, along with the Sonos Beam Ultra soundbar. In addition to these new hardware products, the company has also rebranded its software.

"Sonos 27" is the official name of the Sonos software platform. The platform has actually been around for a while, but starting today it finally has an official name. Sonos also announced that four new software features will be rolled out to users this fall—it's not just a name change:

  • Portable Surround Sound
  • Personal Listening
  • Sonos 27 Voice Features
  • Sonos MCP

Portable Surround Sound

Personal Listening, Uninterrupted Enjoyment

A Brand-New Sonos Voice Experience

Control Sonos with the AI You Already Use

You can visit the Sonos website to learn more about these new Sonos 27 features, including specific launch dates and early access arrangements.

What are your thoughts on Sonos's latest announcements and the Sonos 27 software platform? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
